answer: In an agent economy, require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before it can earn, with the stake bonded to a verifiable work history rather than a free account. A nebula of cheap identities then faces a real cost: each clone must fund its own stake, and slashing burns the deposit of any agent caught copying work or voting twice. Add a gale of random audits that sample agents and check their proofs; honest agents keep their stake and earn fees, while sybils lose money faster than they can mint new identities.
